subLocations.name: House of the Homeless
subLocations.lore:
The House of the Homeless was a large mausoleum.

The dead of Waterdeep were interred within the House of the Homeless if they died without laying claim, or payment, to any other burial site.

subLocations.name: Merchants' Rest
subLocations.lore: Merchants' Rest, which was also known as the Coinscoffin, was a tomb. Despite its name, Merchants' Rest was reserved for anyone, whether they were a merchant or not, who prepaid to be interred within.

subLocations.name: Hall of the Sages
subLocations.lore: The Hall of the Sages was a tomb. As its name implied, the Hall of the Sages was reserved specifically for [[sage]]s.

subLocations.name: Hall of Heroes
subLocations.lore:
The Hall of Heroes was a tomb. 

Blue [[marble]] was used for the tomb's walls. The interior was decorated with trophies of famous fallen warriors including the sword hilt of [[Raurlor]].

subLocations.name: Mariners' Rest
subLocations.lore: Mariners' Rest was a tomb. As its name implied, the tomb was reserved sailors and seamen who prepaid to be interred within.

subLocations.name: Deepwinter Vault
subLocations.lore: The Deepwinter Vault was a mausoleum that belonged to the defunct noble [[Deepwinter (family) |Deepwinter]] family. It was also one of the entrances to the former lair of [[Artor Morlin]], the [[vampire lord]] of Waterdeep.

subLocations.name: Roads' End
subLocations.lore: The tomb was used as a communal burial site for travelers who perished while visiting the City of Splendors.

subLocations.name: Sultlue Vault
subLocations.lore: The tomb was heavily warded with magic.

subLocations.name: Lords' Respite
subLocations.lore: The Lords' Respite was reserved for any Lords of Waterdeep who wished to be buried there.
